question: The value of 3 over4 ÷ 3 over4 of (3)/(4) × 4 over 3 + 5 over 2 ÷ 2 over 5 of 5 over 4 - 2 over 3 - 2 over 3 of 5 over 6 is :
solution:
**Given:**

3 over4 ÷ 3 over4 of (3)/(4) × 4 over 3 + 5 over 2 ÷ 2 over 5 of 5 over 4 - 2 over 3 - 2 over 3 of 5 over 6

**Concept used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/FQDDa_-sk6biu59GgwteVF7ao9-3Pg6HmRfPUV5pOrIHVBXldVVBmkZFtjPwT0n6PH1atIWKcdBGjS9jJ1yZwZYvAexSmkDeSjqE5ShuETfkqB0WSH2Bzlu4Z7sS4BOn8sf8v3_cZqVCTOjk0vLSOQ] 

**Calculation:**

3 over4 ÷ 3 over4 x (3)/(4) × 4 over 3 + 5 over 2 ÷ 2 over 5 x 5 over 4 - 2 over 3 - 2 over 3 x 5 over 6

⇒ 3 over4 ÷ 9 over16 x 4 over 3+ 5 over 2 ÷ 1 over 2 - 2 over 3 - 5 over 9

⇒ 3 over4 x 16 over9 x 4 over 3 + 5 over 2 x 2 - 2 over 3 - 5 over 9

⇒ 16 over 9 + 5 - 2 over 3 - 5 over 9

⇒ (16 +45 - 6 - 5)/(9)

⇒ 50 over 9

**∴ Required answer is 50/9.**
